searchText: Is this intended that `BALANCE` is not affected by delegation? i think so - since it doesn't have anything to do with code loading, it should always just return the balance of the requested address BALANCE of delegated address may produce result different from CALL into this address returning SELFBALANCE... I don't know if this can be an issue they should return the same value? SELFBALANCE would be executing in the context of the called address, not where the code lives oh I see, I missed that
